value.name: reaffirm compassion rule
value.description: Asha reflects on her rule that compassion must not be confused with neutrality, treating it as a necessary boundary.
evidence: She had a rule about that. Compassion was not neutrality, and the rule was the only thing that kept the two from collapsing into each other.

value.name: return to Serrano house
value.description: Asha goes back to the Serrano house in the evening as the rain returns.
evidence: She went back to the Serrano house at half past eight.
The rain had returned, finer now, more like mist.

value.name: Rosa admits Asha
value.description: Rosa lets Asha into the house even though her presence at that hour is technically improper.
evidence: Rosa was not supposed to be there at that hour, technically, but Rosa was there, and Asha did not comment on it.

value.name: find Lucia's letter
value.description: Asha finds a letter addressed to Lucia waiting in the sewing room.
evidence: Lucia was in the sewing room at the back of the house, a small bright room with a treadle machine in the corner and a window that looked out on the garden where the wisteria was sleeping.
The letter was on the worktable, in an envelope with Lucia's name written on the front in blue ink.

value.name: read the letter
value.description: Asha reads the letter standing in the sewing room and recognizes the handwriting as the same one she had been studying all afternoon.
evidence: The signature at the bottom was the same firm round hand she had been looking at all afternoon.

value.name: reveal house transfer
value.description: The letter reveals that the house has been formally given to Lucia after years of delay.
evidence: I have done something I should have done five years ago.
Mr. Pinsky came today and we have set it down properly. The house is yours.

value.name: justify inheritance decision
value.description: The letter explains that Lucia receives the house because she stayed there when the writer was afraid, and the house remembers that.
evidence: Not because Daniel does not deserve a house.
Because you have been the one who slept under this roof when I was afraid, and a house remembers that.

value.name: compensate Daniel
value.description: The writer says she has given Daniel money to balance the gift of the house.
evidence: I have given him money to make it even.

value.name: warn Lucia about Daniel
value.description: The letter warns Lucia that Daniel will be hurt and asks her to be patient with him.
evidence: He will be hurt and you will have to be patient with him.
You are better at patience than he is.

value.name: praise Lucia's patience
value.description: The letter closes this section by affirming Lucia's patience and character as something Daniel has not fully recognized.
evidence: You have always been better than he knows.
